processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Homogenization in a muffle furnace, shared by the alloy fabrication route preceding the modified A5 processing.

Relatively high-speed hot rolling at 10 rpm (against 1 rpm in the previous route), reducing plate thickness from 14 to 2 mm (slightly more). Rolling temperature is not explicitly restated for the modified route in b0032 (the standard route used 1050–900 °C).
1 mm thickness reduction by cold rolling after the modified high-speed hot rolling; cold-rolling temperature is not explicitly restated for the modified route in b0032.
Annealing at 900 °C for 5 min followed by water quenching; the modified route anneals for 5–30 min with A5, A15, A30 explicitly labeled.

structures.overall_structure: Banded γ-matrix microstructure with refined B2 stringer bands (~11%, reduced from 16%) and softer γ dominant; high-speed HR leaves residual dislocations in less-annealed A5. Annealing also produces intragranular (IG-B2) and intergranular (GB-B2) B2 precipitation in addition to the B2 stringer bands.

phases_present.morphology: softer matrix phase that preferentially absorbs plastic strain; strain concentration is higher in γ
refined lamellar stringer bands aligned along the rolling direction
coarse intergranular B2 particles at grain boundaries
needle-shaped intragranular B2 nucleated at shear bands

defects.dislocation_density: higher in modified A5 (left behind by high-speed HR) than in longer-annealed samples

precipitates.distribution: lamellar bands aligned along rolling direction, ~11% fraction
needle-shaped intragranular precipitates at shear bands

phases_present.morphology: elongated aligned B2 stringer bands in a lighter γ matrix
lighter matrix between B2 stringer bands

phase_interfaces.coherence: nonshearable B2 intermetallic; strain incompatibility between softer γ and harder B2 gives rise to yield point elongation

defect_interactions.interaction_type: micro-crack pinning/nucleation at B2 stringer bands
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: micro-crack pinned at B2 stringer bands near the specimen edge; reduced crack susceptibility in modified A5

defect_interactions.interaction_type: dislocation localization at γ/B2 phase interfaces near grain boundaries
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: dislocations released from softer γ localize around GB-B2 at γ/B2 interfaces, reducing geometrically necessary dislocation density in bulk

interfaces.slip_behavior: Two-stage strain hardening: softer γ accommodates more strain than harder B2; strain incompatibility produces weak yield point elongation at the onset of yielding.
interfaces.phase_evolution: High-speed HR refines B2 stringer bands (fraction 16%→11%), making softer γ dominant and improving crack resistance; less-annealed A5 retains residual dislocations.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: ASTM E8, rolling direction, gauge length 12.5 mm, gauge width 3 mm, thickness 2 mm
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: 100 kN Instron 5982 with 10 mm gauge extensometer

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Engineering stress–strain curve of modified A5 reported in Figure 6a (panel not supplied in the available text).

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: Modified high-speed HR (10 rpm) refines B2 stringer bands (fraction 16%→11%), making softer γ dominant; this improves strength–ductility balance, raises YS to ~1 GPa, and reduces crack susceptibility compared with the previous 1 rpm HR + CR route.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: 100 kN Instron 5982 with 10 mm gauge extensometer
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: room temperature; ASTM E8; rolling direction; gauge length 12.5 mm, gauge width 3 mm, thickness 2 mm; 1 mm/min crosshead velocity
characterization_methods.purpose: measure engineering stress–strain response (yield strength, ductility, toughness)
characterization_methods.key_findings: modified A5 (less annealed) exhibits higher strength among modified annealed samples; modified-route YS ~1 GPa

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: true stress–true strain data; linear fits of lnσ versus lnε
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: derived from uniaxial tensile true stress–true strain curves
characterization_methods.purpose: determine two-stage strain hardening exponent n
characterization_methods.key_findings: modified A5: n = 0.069 (initial YPE stage), n = 0.179 (second stage)

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: optical microscope (Leica DM2700 M per b0012 methods)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: deformed tensile gauge near the crack tip
characterization_methods.purpose: assess crack susceptibility of modified A5
characterization_methods.key_findings: elongated B2 stringer bands with a micro-crack pinned near the specimen edge; reduced crack susceptibility

computational_details.validation_against_experiment: n values obtained from best linear fits of lnσ versus lnε on experimental true stress–strain curves

analytical_models.model_note: Two-stage strain hardening: initially low n due to yield point elongation, followed by combined plastic deformation of γ and B2.

unmapped_findings: Thermo-Calc thermodynamic calculations (TCFE database) computed the pseudo-binary phase diagram, phase fractions, and solute partitioning for the Fe–10Al–15Mn–0.8C–5Ni alloy; the disorder-order transition δ→B2 at 1125 °C and the eutectoid reaction at 851 °C frame the 900 °C annealing used for modified A5. This is alloy-level computation, not specific to modified A5 alone (b0014, figure_001).

Headline properties in the abstract: 'nearly 1 GPa yield strength, 28% total elongation, and over 1.7 kJ mol^-1 (or 238.4 J cm^-3) toughness' represent the overall modified-processing outcome; the 1.72 kJ mol^-1 (238 J cm^-3) toughness is specifically attributed to A30, not to modified A5 (b0003, b0032, b0044).

Statement in b0033 that 'the current microstructural modulation rules out that possibility with 16% GB-B2 and 3.7% IG-B2' is ambiguous for this sample: the 3.7% IG-B2 equals 2.6% (URE-γ) + 1.1% (RE-γ) from the standard-route Figure 3 measurements, and 16% is elsewhere attributed to B2 stringer bands (standard route) before modification reduced them to 11%.

Detailed IG-B2/GB-B2 precipitate quantification (needle-shaped IG-B2 0.2 μm / 2.6% in URE-γ; spherical coarse IG-B2 0.29 μm / 1.1% in RE-γ; total 66 MPa precipitation strengthening) was characterized on the standard 900 °C annealing route (Figure 3), not explicitly re-quantified for modified A5, so those values were not assigned to this sample (b0026, b0040).

Modified-route overall comparison: toughness of 1.72 kJ mol^-1 (or 238 J cm^-3) in A30 is reported to be comparable to TRIP-aided steel (nearly 0.5–1.5 kJ mol^-1 or 69–207.8 J cm^-3); this overall comparison is not a modified-A5-specific value (b0032).
